intro: You made it all the way here.
You really seem to enjoy reading profiles.
If you made it this far, I'd be happy if you let me know.

sections.title: Why VRChat
paragraphs: I actually logged into VRChat once around 2018. I opened the default home world, got scared, and closed it. I'm kind of a coward, honestly.
I had an Oculus Rift back then, but I only played Beat Saber. PUBG was still popular, and Fall Guys had just come out, I think. Nostalgic.
A few years later, around 2024, a friend invited me—that was how I started again. I've been playing on and off since.
For the first six months or so, I mostly hung out in game worlds. Lately I feel like I come here more to chat.
I'm actually a bit lonely at heart, so it secretly makes me happy when people leave messages or drop into my worlds. I won't say that out loud, though.
I'm getting embarrassed, so I'll wrap this up here. That's the gist of it.

sections.title: Travel & Onsen
paragraphs: My hobbies are games, hot springs, and drinks. I've been to all kinds of onsen, but I barely remember the names...
Sand baths are my favorite—the fun and the feel. You can try one in Ibusuki, Kagoshima. It's a bit pricey, but I recommend Ibusuki Hakusuikan. Check it out if you can.
If you're in Kansai, I recommend the cave bath at Hotel Urashima. It's truly a one-of-a-kind experience. The price is reasonable and you can even visit for the day, so definitely check it out.

For regular hot springs, I recommend Ookawaso. For a while people said it looked like the Infinity Castle from Demon Slayer. In autumn you can see the mountain foliage, bridge, and river all at once—it's beautiful.

sections.title: Drinks
paragraphs: There was a time I went to a bar alone about five times a week.
I had a game of ordering cocktails from the top-left of the menu in order, but I don't remember much... I ended up liking Passoa with pineapple juice best—that's the one thing I kept.
These days I only go occasionally; at home I drink beer, plum wine, or highballs.
